description: Implementation of a simple FIFO queue in C, including functions for creating, destroying, pushing, popping, deleting, finding, iterating, and clearing queue items.

methods.name: queueCreate
methods.description: Creates a new queue object, initializes it to empty.

methods.name: queueDestroy
methods.description: Destroys the queue, freeing all items and the queue structure itself.

methods.name: queueCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the queue.

methods.name: queuePush
methods.description: Adds an item to the end of the queue.

methods.name: queuePop
methods.description: Removes and returns the item at the front of the queue.

methods.name: queueDelete
methods.description: Deletes a specific item from the queue based on a search function.

methods.name: queueFind
methods.description: Finds and returns an item in the queue based on a search function.

methods.name: queueIterate
methods.description: Iterates over the queue, calling a callback for each item.

methods.name: queueClear
methods.description: Clears all items from the queue, freeing memory.
